page_title: REN 0-2 LOR | Rennes v Lorient 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
83' The Lorient players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
81' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Breel Embolo is replaced by Elias Legendre (Rennes).
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
77' 0 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Pablo Pagis (Lorient) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
76' Substitution. Mahdi Camara leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes).
74' Olivier Pantaloni decides to make a substitution. Bamba Dieng will be replaced by Sambou Soumano (Lorient).
74' Substitution. Igor Silva did his best and is replaced by Nathaniel Adjei (Lorient).

74' Lilian Brassier delivers a perfect cross for Breel Embolo (Rennes), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
73' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
73' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alidu Seidu (Rennes) brought his opponent down.
72' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Yvon Mvogo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
68' Rennes are ruled offside.
67' A player from Rennes commits a rough challenge. Clement Turpin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
65' Breel Embolo (Rennes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
63' The substitution has been made. Arthur Avom (Lorient) has replaced Jean-Victor Makengo.
63' Dermane Karim comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Pagis (Lorient).
60' Substitution. Djaoui Cisse will be replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
60' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Meite (Rennes) replacing Esteban Lepaul.
60' Substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski walks off the pitch and Mousa Tamari (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
58' Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Yvon Mvogo (Lorient).
56' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaps to collect the ball.
55' Dermane Karim (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
52' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Bamba Dieng (Lorient) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

49' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
48' Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

47' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Yvon Mvogo stops the ball from going into the top left corner. The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Yvon Mvogo is equal to it.
44' The corner kick from Quentin Merlin (Rennes) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
43' The total number of attempts is 7:3.
42' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
41' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
37' What a wasted opportunity by Esteban Lepaul (Rennes)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Yvon Mvogo makes a decent save to thwart him.

37' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rennes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
37' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Lorient won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
32' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
32' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
30' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Breel Embolo (Rennes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
25' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) takes a short corner kick.
22' None of the Rennes players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
19' Today's referee Clement Turpin rightly decides to book Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) for his harsh tackle.

17' That was absolutely fantastic! Alidu Seidu (Rennes) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the left post! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.

15' A cross is whipped in towards Breel Embolo (Rennes) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
13' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.

12' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Brice Samba shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Neat passing move from Lorient in order to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Dermane Karim (Lorient) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

5' Lorient players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a throw-in.
4' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.

3' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Brice Samba just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rennes will kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
